attchmntText: KN Agri Resources Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: KN Agri Resources Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 14th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 898.51 Crores. Profit before tax stood at 24.15 Crores. Profit after tax was 18.19 Crores. Earnings per share were 7.28. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 389.43 Crores. Profit before tax was 6.30 Crores. Profit after tax was 4.77 Crores. Earnings per share were 1.91. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report with no qualifications.
